root_cause.text: The driver fails to re-anchor completed URBs in the `mcba_usb_read_bulk_callback()` before resubmitting them, so they are not freed by `usb_kill_anchored_urbs()` during device close, leading to a URB memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in usb_kill_anchored_urbs()." The patch adds `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &priv->rx_submitted)` before resubmission and `usb_unanchor_urb(urb)` on failure.
